params.linkText: pricing of an underwritten public offering

children: of 5.77M shares of common stock at $26.00 per share, for an expected gross proceeds of approximately $150M.
Yarrow granted underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 865,384 shares.

The transaction's net proceeds will be used to advance research and development across the company's autoimmune thyroid disease pipeline and support general corporate purposes, including working capital and capital expenditures.
The transaction is scheduled to close on September 14, 2026.
All shares in the offering are being sold directly by Yarrow.
